notes:
November 27th 2026
Version 13.18.19 (stable) / 13.19.19 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* SET files: Open in R-Editor works for every SET. (R)
* Typing over On/Off/STD values now sticks. (K,R)
* R-Editor: no blank page after Print Report. (R)
* Clearer help when no accordion is found. (R)
* Title Bar Only Mode keeps the USB drive list. (K,R)
* MIDI Monitor: less battery use when left open. (K,R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...
notes_beta:
November 27th 2026
Version 13.18.20 (stable) / 13.19.20 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Score Editor: import a MIDI file as a score. (K,R)
* Live Scoring: fast runs and grace notes stay on the beat. (K,R)
* K-Editor (beta users): matches the FISA screen: values, units and names. (K)
* K-Editor (beta users): accented register names now load on the FISA. (K)
* K-Editor (beta users): scale presets set every note, as on the panel. (K)
* Easier clicks on small number boxes. (K,R)
* Reminder when SET edits are not saved yet. (R)
* See Help->Show Release Notes for More...

Version 13.18.16 (stable) / 13.19.16 (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Large USB drives now listed. (K,R)
